GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down last 8 Lengths 1200m last 7 Lengths 1000m Hooked Out 3 Wide Went Forward 800m 3 Wide 3rd 2 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden Under Pressure 2nd Middle Of Track Straight weakened badly final 250m # back/took off/tired
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. After passing the 1000m was shifted out and allowed to improve around the field, however, was forced wider and was required to remain racing wide and without cover from that point. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities than a superficial abrasion to the off foreleg.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: slow out x 2-3L. Settled Down last 9 Lengths @ 1100m. Took off from 800m, Straightened Up a Clear 2nd! Took over 200m, then $21 stablemate Winner Had Last Crack # midrace move/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Missed the start (3L). Near the 900m, commenced to race keenly and had to be steadied from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: 3L slow away. Beaten for early speed & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace until improving 3 Wide @ 550m. Pushed out Five Wide @ 400m & pushed along Seven Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 250m & ran on OK in last 200m. # Best work last 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stewards permitted rider to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight of 55.5kg. Stood flat footed and missed the start (3L). Stable representative was advised that a warning would be placed on the mare’s record.
Slow to begin. Raced ungenerously in the early sates and as a result raced wide without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: 2 Lengths slow away. Pushed to recover & raced @ rear (out of picture) early . Stayed out of picture until improving on inside from 700m.Pushed to quicken Two Wide (5L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & back to rail @ 150m. Held ground late. # Slow out/fair.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Stood flat footed and lost ground, then showed no early pace in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Settled last rails off poor start 8 Lengths 800m, worked widest before the corner, Made Some Ground last 200m but from too far back # best work late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages of the event. When questioned regarding his vigour over the concluding stages, rider advised that his whip had become entangled in his reins resulting in having to ride his mount out hands and heels for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 8l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
Slow Out 2 lengths Settled Down last 10 lengths. last turn. made some ground # slow away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin by two lengths and was slow into stride.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: 3L slow away. Recovered & raced @ rear Two Wide (6L from lead) early . Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & out 3 Wide @ 600m. Pushed to quicken Five Wide @ 400m & chasing Seven Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & laid in @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 150m. Shaded in last 100m. # Good from rear.
Bit Slow Out settled back 6l off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After being slow to begin, was shifted behind runners from the outside barrier.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out 2 Lengths settled last 10l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well along rail # slow start costly
Ms3len Settled Down last fence 10len came off fence 500m but made no ground final 300m # Missed start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Missed the start (2L). Approaching the 400m shifted out and bumped rnr.
